cases.provenance: A human reviewer flagged this defect in an inline comment on the reviewed pull request.
cases.description: Instead of checking `skinWeight.array instanceof Float32Array`, could we check `skinWeight.normalized`? I'm worried the first might break for InterleavedBufferAttributes.

evidence.thread_resolution: zeux: Good point! Not very familiar with this code; I didn't have models with interleaved attributes to test but it is indeed likely to break.
